note: Real public DFIR evidence acquisition manifest. Large/sensitive corpora are never committed to Git; an acquisition script downloads to .runtime/eval-artifacts/dfir/ and verifies the SHA-256 before use. Mismatch aborts.
why_not_cfreds: CFReDS disk/memory images (E01/RM, 7.4G) do not match the currently-qualified TRUDI Full toolset (hash/strings/YARA/chainsaw EVTX only; Volatility, Plaso, Sleuth Kit, EZ Tools, tshark are not qualified in this deployment). EICAR is a small, real, public, legally-redistributable artifact that the qualified single-file toolset can analyze deterministically.

corpus.name: EICAR Standard Anti-Virus Test File
corpus.license_or_redistribution: Published by EICAR/AMTSO as a standard test signature for antivirus products; freely redistributable for testing/validation. This is a real public artifact, not a self-made ground truth.
corpus.toolset_support: hash (sha256 + verify), strings (extract/grep/identify), yara (scan file/strings), read_output
